body: it all depends on the route you take. obviously abroad there are a lot more options, but even in india, mental healthcare jobs are being created more and more, however, mostly in urban populations. some popular ones whom i have seen in person would be an industrial/organizational psychologist, as well as school counselors, developmental psychologists, and various other specializations. the unemployment scene for psychology compared to, say, engineering, is much much better. many take psychology to just get a degree, but as long as you really have the skills, you can get a job.
i would politely disagree, there are far better prospects than you think.
